title: Gowers seminorm
statement: For a positive integer $k$, define the seminorm on real-valued functions on $\mathbb F_2^n$ obtained from the $k$th Gowers norm.
caveat: The construction uses the upstream Gowers norm and its triangle and scalar-multiplication properties, whose definitions are not included in the payload; the precise norm formula is unavailable.
